bit string types.name: sourceport
bit string types.description: optional field, indicates port of sending process. value zero if not used.

bit string types.name: destinationport
bit string types.description: field with meaning within context of particular internet destination address.

bit string types.name: length
bit string types.description: length in octets of this user datagram including header and data. minimum value eight.

structure types.name: userdatagramheader

fields.name: source address
fields.description: field containing ip address information for the source.

fields.name: destination address
fields.description: field containing ip address information for the destination.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: field indicating the protocol for the datagram.

fields.name: length
fields.description: field containing the length of the udp header and data.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: field containing the udp checksum of the pseudo-header and data.

structure types.serialize to: ip header, udp header, and data

parsing context.name: pseudoheader
parsing context.description: information from the ip header is needed to calculate the checksum.

parsing context.name: checksum
parsing context.description: 16-bit one's complement of sum of ip pseudo-header, udp header, and data.

helper functions.name: calculate checksum
helper functions.description: calculates checksum by summing all fields and taking 16-bit one's complement

helper functions.name: compute pseudo header
helper functions.description: constructs the pseudo-header from ip header information
